explication: This is a Go command-line client for App Store Connect, with Apple Ads and StoreKit integrations. The principal workflow is a user invoking a command, the CLI dispatching to a domain command, that command using authenticated API clients to read or change Apple-managed resources, and results being rendered for terminal or scripted use. Major command families cover apps, builds and TestFlight, metadata and review, analytics, signing, and release operations. Source excerpts confirm selected calls; README statements support the broader command-to-API workflow, while unsampled subsystem links are omitted.
